print.label: Printed invoice
print.help: How the invoice prints from Orders → Packing & print → Invoices. "Paper": A4 or A5 for a paper invoice. "Roll": 80 or 58 mm for a thermal printer; the roll is as long as the invoice. "Dots per inch": your printer's (203 for most thermal printers). "Language": the printed words (names and the address print as the order stores them). "Barcode": the courier's consignment barcode, once the parcel is booked. "Logo": your logo from Brand settings at the top instead of the shop name. "Most per print": how many invoices one press takes. What the invoice says is set in "Invoice content".

image.label: Invoice for a chat
image.help: The copy of the invoice sent in a chat (WhatsApp and the others, once connected): a full-page picture (JPG) or the PDF. "Width": the picture's width in pixels; its height follows the invoice. "Quality": the JPG quality (higher is sharper and bigger).

issue.label: Issuing invoices
issue.help: On: every placed order gets its invoice (its number and what it showed) without anyone opening it. A background job looks every few minutes at orders changed in the last few days ("Look back") and takes at most this many orders a run; an older order gets its invoice the moment it is opened or printed. When an order's items, money, name or address are edited, the invoice gets a new version with the same number; a payment or a delivery never makes a new version.
